tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap performed the bulk Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite and preserved .uwp-source; scaffold built after merge (TURN 41 'Build succeeded').
Native dotnet build surfaced the actionable CS1061 errors that pinpointed the UWP-only lifecycle events (TURN 34).

tool_limitations.limitation: Classifies <CaptureElement> as 'unsupported' (any hit -> defer), which forces the migration to abandon the central live-camera-preview feature even though a fully-supported replacement exists.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Reclassify CaptureElement as 'adaptable' with an anchor to a camera-preview recipe (MediaFrameReader -> SoftwareBitmapSource -> Image).

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP MainPage subscribes to these in OnNavigatedTo to pause/resume the camera.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no Suspending/Resuming events in WinUI 3 desktop (CS1061).
failed_apis.fix: Removed the event subscriptions and the handlers; gate UI activity on App.MainWindow.AppWindow.IsVisible / Window.Activated instead.

doc_errors.where: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### CS0246 / WMC0001: CaptureElement could not be found' and 'Unsupported on WinUI 3 Desktop' list
doc_errors.wrong: States CaptureElement has 'no compatible replacement' and the file must be deferred.
doc_errors.correct: Live camera preview IS migratable: run MediaCapture, create a MediaFrameReader (CreateFrameReaderAsync), convert each SoftwareBitmap to Bgra8/Premultiplied, push into a SoftwareBitmapSource bound to an <Image>. Scored 100/100 in this trial.

special_apis.special_handling: Replace XAML <CaptureElement> with <Image>; drive it from MediaCapture.CreateFrameReaderAsync + SoftwareBitmapSource (SoftwareBitmap.Convert to Bgra8/Premultiplied before SetBitmapAsync).
UWP Suspending/Resuming hooks are gone; use Window.Activated + AppWindow.IsVisible to decide when to start/stop the preview.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'Application' does not contain a definition for 'Suspending' / 'Resuming'
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP Application lifecycle events do not exist on Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application.
errors_encountered.fix: Delete the += / -= subscriptions and the now-dead handlers; remove the _isSuspending gate.

errors_encountered.error: AppxManifest splash image [Splash-sdk.png] cannot be located / runFullTrust deploy failure
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP manifest's -sdk branded asset references copied over the scaffold without the asset files; Windows.Universal target / missing runFullTrust.
errors_encountered.fix: Already documented in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md manifest checklist; kept scaffold asset references and Windows.Desktop + runFullTrust.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS1061 on Application.Suspending/Resuming, then cascading cleanup of the handlers and _isSuspending field
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill lifecycle section covers OnLaunched/activation but never states the Suspending/Resuming events are removed in WinUI 3 desktop.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Removed subscriptions, handlers, and the _isSuspending gate; rebuilt clean.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A lifecycle-section note: 'Application.Suspending/Resuming do not exist in WinUI 3 desktop — delete page subscriptions; use Window.Activated / AppWindow.IsVisible.'

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Skill instructed deferring the only feature of the app; agent overrode it to keep parity
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill wrongly classifies CaptureElement live preview as having no migration path.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent built MediaFrameReader + SoftwareBitmapSource preview into an Image; scored 100.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Replace the 'defer CaptureElement' guidance with the supported preview recipe and reclassify the inventory entry as adaptable.

env_issues.issue: No camera present on the build machine
env_issues.workaround: App correctly keeps Photo/Video buttons disabled (matching UWP ground truth) and shows a 'No camera device found' fallback message.
